titel: GPT-6 Astra is a banger - here’s everything I’ve built

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Hands-on review of GPT-6 Astra, covering computer use, complex coding, and custom 3D apps.
kurzfassung: GPT-6 Astra brings significant improvements to computer use, allowing the AI to autonomously navigate complex software and workflows. The model excels at challenging coding tasks, successfully one-shotting product intelligence features and custom hardware integrations. It also enables users to build intricate 3D games and desktop applications with unprecedented ease.
stichpunkte: GPT-6 Astra introduces major advancements in speed, mathematical reasoning, and autonomous computer use.
The model demonstrates strong browser and software navigation across tools like CRMs, design platforms, and code editors.
Complex coding challenges, such as aggregating product insights from multiple data sources, are handled in a single prompt.
Hardware hacking projects, including interfacing with Bluetooth devices and creating custom command-line tools, become achievable.
Users can generate 3D assets and build interactive web games using Blender and one-shot prompts.
Astra supports the creation of unique desktop apps, such as a 1990s-style messenger wrapper for AI chat threads.

clips.hook: Trimming hours of manual tasks down to minutes
clips.text: The new model drastically reduces the time needed for routine chores like searching for apartments or producing thumbnails.
Complex software navigation no longer requires manual input, transforming how humans interact with websites and digital tools.
Tasks that previously caused earlier iterations to fail repeatedly are now resolved on the very first attempt.

clips.hook: Merging modern workflows with retro nostalgia
clips.text: Active development threads are repackaged inside a nostalgic instant messaging interface reminiscent of the late nineties.

clips.hook: A definitive verdict on the latest release
clips.text: The new language model earns high praise for its exceptional performance in both browser automation and software development.

beschreibung:
I got early access to GPT-6 Astra: when I say this model broke through tasks I couldn’t crack with 5.6 Sol or Fable, I mean it specifically: the ChatPRD product intelligence feature, building 3D games, the hardware hack, and a handful of one-shot coding projects I’d tried and failed on repeatedly.

What you’ll learn:
Why Astra’s computer use feels different, and which production tools I’m trusting it with
The one feature I’d thrown every model at for six months, and what finally got it to 90%
How I’m using browser use for QA, not building, and what it found that I would’ve missed
Why I think UI is genuinely back, and what that means for SaaS and MCPs
The hardware hack I’d been chasing since GPT-5.5, and how Astra finally cracked it
What Astra built me in Blender in one shot, and why 3D is my new capability benchmark
The AIM-style Mac app Astra made in one shot, and what it signals about desktop development now
An honest take on speed, cost, and whether Astra is worth making your daily driver

—
In this episode, we cover:
(00:00) GPT-6 Astra overview
(03:44) Browser/computer use test on my CRM
(09:08) Flora thumbnail generation
(13:00) Browser use for QA
(15:20) Coding: ChatPRD product intelligence feature, finally one-shotted
(18:36) Hardware hack: Divoom MiniToo CLI and live streaming display
(22:23) Building an AIM-style Mac app
(24:24) Blender and 3D assets: Barbie Bench and the kids’ family app
(28:52) Summary: what Astra is great at and what to try first
